glossary.definition: Message requesting settlement of a financial instrument.
Confirmation message indicating successful processing of a settlement request.
Persistent record written before each outbound acknowledge message is transmitted, containing the target system identifier, payload hash, and transmission timestamp.

business_rules.rule: Before transmitting an acknowledge message, System-A must persist a delivery log entry; if transmission fails, System-A must retry delivery at 30-second intervals for up to 10 minutes before escalating to an operations alert.
